# Dependencies for the read-only dashboard API (run_dashboard_api.py /
# app/backend/*) ONLY. Kept separate from requirements.txt on purpose --
# requirements.txt is installed fresh on every trader.yml scanner run
# (see that file's header comment) and must stay minimal; this file is
# installed once, by hand, on whatever host/container/VM you run the
# dashboard API on, and is never touched by the scanner job.
#
# Pinned to exact versions for the same reason requirements.txt is:
# no unpinned floor that lets pip silently pick a new major/minor
# release on a fresh install. Bump deliberately after testing locally.
fastapi==0.111.0
uvicorn[standard]==0.30.1
